messages:
emma: FYI bringing up magnet-30b-int4v3 on a dedicated pool for longctx experiments. seeing weird fragmentation at the 1st gateway boundary when prefill > 65k tokens.
liam: can you paste the minimal repro? is this during prefill or during in-flight decode?
emma: happens during prefill -> we stream a 80k token prompt, then a short continuation. model returns correct logits but repeat/dropped tokens around the 65536->65537 boundary.
anika: that smells like a 64k paging/fence issue, maybe buffer math or host<->gpu transfer chunking. which runtime image?
emma: runtime: rdx-runtime:v2.9.1-int4v3, compiled kernels q4->int4 path. dedicated pool on g5x. deploy-bot: model deploy started: magnet-30b-int4v3 -> pool-dedicated-3
sergey: do we have KV-index offsets saved per-shard? if an index wraps incorrectly you get a fragment stitch hole.
emma: we dumped the KV offsets. brief log snippet:
```
[2026-02-12T14:12:03Z] prefill_part=0 tokens=65536 kv_offset=65536
[2026-02-12T14:12:03Z] prefill_part=1 tokens=14528 kv_offset=80064
[2026-02-12T14:12:03Z] stitch: expected_offset=80064 seen_offset=80032
```
liam: stitch mismatch by 32 tokens. that's not a RoPE scale but an indexing misalign. any recent change to chunk_size or memcpy pad? anika: we did change prefetch chunk to 32B alignment in the memcpy patch last week.
emma: rolling back that memcpy alignment patch on a canary image to test.
sergey: also try forcing `--kv-seq-align=64` at runtime to see if it's just alignment policy. if it fixes, we know patch broke offset rounding.
emma: quick test on canary passed: no fragment gap after rollback. hypothesis: prefetch alignment changed how the final block length is computed, off-by-chunk.
liam: good catch. do we need a unit test that streams cross-boundary prefill sizes? add a fuzz harness: random long prefills with boundary sizes: 65535,65536,65537,65568.
anika: i'll add a smoke test to the longctx CI job and a metric for `stitch_gap_bytes`. also add a regression alert to rollout if stitch_gap>0.
emma: PR incoming for rollback + test. thanks. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: model deploy succeeded: magnet-30b-int4v3 -> pool-dedicated-3 (canary)
sergey: follow-up: we should also test on quantized variants with different prefill chunking, plus a synthetic with repeated single-token prefill to exercise tiny-block edge cases.
liam: agreed. i'll own the test matrix. will run overnight and report in morning.
emma: leaving the logs and kv-dumps in /mnt/experiments/1718099999/ if anyone wants to re-run.
